definitions.explanation: The negative sign (-) in mathematics. Opposite of {正|せい} (positive).

examples.japanese: {正|せい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{符号|ふごう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{負|ふ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{符号|ふごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{区別|くべつ}→区別：01555_kubetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Distinguish between positive and negative signs.

notes:
{負|ふ} indicates something negative, minus, or unfavorable in technical and abstract contexts.

MATHEMATICAL USAGE:
- {負|ふ}の{数|すう}: negative number
- {負|ふ}の{値|あたい}: negative value
- {負|ふ}の{符号|ふごう}: minus sign (-)
- Opposite: {正|せい} (positive)

EXTENDED USAGE:
- {負|ふ}の{遺産|いさん}: negative legacy
- {負|ふ}の{連鎖|れんさ}: vicious cycle, negative chain
- {負|ふ}の{影響|えいきょう}: negative influence
- {勝|か}ち{負|ま}け: win or lose

OTHER READINGS OF {負|ふ}:
The kanji {負|ふ} has multiple readings with different meanings:
- {負|ま}ける: to lose (a game/competition)
- {負|お}う: to bear, carry on one's back
- {負|ま}かす: to defeat

These are all separate dictionary entries.
